en: Black‑and‑white street view of a multi‑storey historic building with dormer windows and a central arched gateway. On the façade is a large sign reading "Dollroths Gasthaus" with smaller text beneath. Next door is another building with a shopfront sign "Moritz Erdmann". An early 20th‑century automobile is parked on the street in front, suggesting the scene was photographed in the interwar period. The architecture is typical of a central European town house row.
